policy.text:
Northwind Ltd — Expense Policy (London, UK). All amounts in GBP.

§1 General. Expenses must have a clear business purpose and be submitted within 60 days.

§2 Receipts. An itemised receipt is required for any expense over £25. Expenses of £25 or less do not need a receipt.

§3 Team meals. Meals where only Northwind staff attend are capped at £30 per head, including service. Alcohol is not reimbursable at team meals.

§4 Client entertainment. Meals with at least one external client are capped at £80 per head, including service. The names and companies of the client attendees must be given. Alcohol is allowed.

§5 Taxis and ride-hailing. Allowed only when public transport is impractical: journeys between 21:00 and 06:00, journeys with heavy equipment, or trips to or from an airport with luggage. Otherwise use public transport.

§6 Rail. Standard class only, unless the journey is longer than 3 hours, in which case first class is allowed.

§7 Hotels. Capped at £180 per night in London and £120 per night elsewhere in the UK.

§8 Software and subscriptions. Need a manager approval reference (format APR-1234).

§9 Not reimbursable. Personal items, fines and penalties, gym and wellbeing memberships.
